0022600109.text: The Dallas Mavericks (1-1, 9th in the West, on a one-game winning streak) host the San Antonio Spurs (0-2, 12th in the West, on a two-game losing streak), and both teams are past their openers. Dallas is without Cooper Flagg (out, shoulder soreness) and Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), and Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Jett Howard (calf soreness), Kyrie Irving (rest), Santi Aldama (knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery), while Tobias Harris (calf strain) is day-to-day with a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Mavericks were swept 0-4 by the Spurs in 2025-26, including a 139-120 loss in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
